$comment: Public-site wording for every Miles product. What is sold, its release status and whether it can be trialed come from the application registry and database/erp-products.json (registry.type + registry.code); an entry without a registry record is shown as coming soon. Features of a product that is not released describe what it is being built to do. offering says how each product runs today: platforms (web, desktop, android, ios), connectivity (online, offline_sync, offline), licensing (subscription, one_time, quotation), and what its desktop and mobile apps do; list only what is built. highlights are the short points on the home page.

products.name: Pharmacy ERP

desktop: The counter on a Windows PC: sell, take cash in and out, and run your shift
Keeps selling when the internet stops; sales wait in an outbox and are sent, once only, when the connection is back
Barcode scanners and keyboard shortcuts at the till
A standalone single-branch edition with its own database on the PC, for a pharmacy with no internet at all
mobile: Sell, dispense prescriptions, take payment and run your shift on a phone or tablet
Print to Bluetooth receipt printers on Android, or share the receipt
A sale made without a connection can be queued and sent later; prescriptions are never queued

products.summary: Medicines, batches and expiry, the counter and prescriptions, with Finance & Accounting when you want the books.
products.headline: Every medicine accounted for, from delivery to dispensing.
products.subhead: Batch and expiry tracking, a fast counter, prescriptions and a controlled-drugs register. Add Finance & Accounting and sales, stock and cash post to your books on their own.
products.audience: Retail pharmacies, medical stores and pharmaceutical wholesalers, from one branch to many.
products.seoTitle: Pharmacy ERP with batch and expiry tracking
products.seoDescription: Pharmacy software with batch and expiry tracking, expiry-first selling, prescriptions, a controlled-drugs register and tills, with optional Finance & Accounting.

features.title: Medicines catalogue
features.body: Generic and brand names, strength, form, barcode and storage condition. Flag prescription-only and controlled items; sell packs or units at their own price.

features.title: Batches and expiry
features.body: Every batch carries its number, expiry date and cost. The counter sells the batch that expires first and blocks anything expired.

features.title: Quarantine and recalls
features.body: Put a batch on hold in one step. Quarantined stock can be released; recalled stock never sells.

features.title: A fast counter
features.body: Search or scan, apply approved discounts, take cash, mobile money or card, and print an 80 mm receipt.

features.title: Prescriptions
features.body: Record prescriptions, have a pharmacist verify them, and dispense part of one when stock is short.

features.title: Controlled drugs register
features.body: Every movement of a controlled item, logged and ready for inspection.

features.title: Tills and cash-up
features.body: Each cashier opens a till and counts it at closing; any over or short is recorded, and posted to Finance when you use it.

features.title: Purchasing and stock
features.body: Purchase orders, goods received onto a shelf or fridge, supplier returns, branch transfers and second-person disposals.

features.title: Reports
features.body: Stock, near-expiry, sales, profitability, purchases and cashier reconciliation, all exportable to CSV.

workflow.title: Receive
workflow.body: Goods arrive against a purchase order, by batch and expiry; with Finance, the supplier bill appears there too.

workflow.title: Sell and dispense
workflow.body: The counter picks the batch that expires first and checks prescriptions before dispensing.

workflow.title: Close the day
workflow.body: Tills are counted and the day's sales are in the reports; with Finance, they are already in the ledger.

faqs.question: Does it work for several branches?
faqs.answer: Yes. Each branch has its own stock, locations and tills, with transfers between branches and reports per branch.

faqs.question: Is accounting included?
faqs.answer: Finance & Accounting is an optional add-on. Pharmacy ERP runs on its own; add Finance and every sale, purchase, return and write-off posts to it automatically.

faqs.answer: Yes. Pharmacy and Retail run side by side in one workspace and each reports on its own. With Finance & Accounting they share one set of books.

features.title: Tax

features.title: Multi-currency
features.body: Foreign-currency accounts, invoices and payments, daily rates and month-end revaluation.

features.title: Budgets and fixed assets
features.body: Budget against actuals, and an asset register with monthly depreciation.

features.title: Reports
features.body: Trial balance, profit and loss, balance sheet, aged receivables and payables, and cash flow.

workflow.title: Record
workflow.body: Sales and purchases arrive from your ERP, or are entered in Finance & Accounting directly.

workflow.title: Reconcile

workflow.title: Report
